messages:
Ruth Park: Quick ask 1: partners want a single "slotting + embargo" sheet for H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi. Can we confirm owners and blockers?
Tomas Vega: I'll take H100/H200/B200 slotting and marketplace gating. Need immutable tags + SBOM from vendors.
Keiko Sato: I'll own MI300/Gaudi coordination and the SI checklist. Early note: Gaudi OEM warns of limited initial rack density in APAC.
Vendor - H: H200 microcode hold only affects ~5% SKUs; patch ETA 2026-04-18. We'll provide tag h200-2026-04-18 and SBOM by EOD.
Vendor - Gaudi: MI300 early power bins will throttled under sustained 40k token windows; recommend mi300-quant for launch. Perf matrix to follow.
Ruth Park: Proposed embargo rules: partners get a 10-day marketing embargo; internal verification window = 72h image + SBOM signoff; canary: 24h staging smoke + 48h limited prod (5%). Auto-fallback allowed on 5xx spike or p99 > baseline*1.25. Agree?
Tomas Vega: Agree. Add token-cost delta alert >20% as trigger. Also require an immutable image hash in marketplace before canary.
Keiko Sato: SI checklist draft items: kernel driver version, container image tag, helm values for device-plugin, smoke script, perf regression test harness, rollback playbook. Will post link.
ops-bot: Canary job queued by @Ruth Park  job #6007. Results will post to #eng-oncall.
Vendor - H: We'll drop smoke scripts (minimal curl example) and image hash by tomorrow 10:00 PT.
Ruth Park: Action items: (1) Vendors: tags + SBOMs + smoke scripts (2) Tomas: reserve marketplace promo slots and add embargo calendar (3) Keiko: publish SI checklist + playbook (4) Ops: codify canary triggers.
Tomas Vega: I'll reserve us-west + eu-west promo slots and circulate calendar invite. If tags miss tomorrow AM, we slide the public date.
Keiko Sato: I'll ping integrators after SBOMs land. Example smoke curl to include in checklist: ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"mi300-quant","seq_len":2048,"requests":100}'```
Ruth Park: Thanks. I'll coordinate with marketing/legal for the embargo handshake once vendor artifacts are posted. :thumbsup:
